description:
Send or schedule a broadcast.

Queues a draft for delivery to every subscribed contact of its audience. The broadcast needs `html` or `text`.
Without `scheduled_at` it starts immediately; the status becomes `queued`, then `sending` and `sent`.

Sends to every subscribed contact in the audience. Run get_broadcast_readiness first and confirm with the user.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `POST /broadcasts/{id}/send` (operationId `sendBroadcast`, Broadcasts).

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time or natural language such as "in 1 hour" or "in 2 days". At most 30 days ahead.

name: send_broadcast
title: Send or schedule a broadcast
